title: Forgotten weapon
wikitext:
[[Forgotten weapon]]s are the [[Reward trophy#End-game reward trophies|end-game items]] given to the player after having defeated [[Abaddon]] in [[Abaddon's Gate]], the last mission of [[Guild Wars Nightfall]].

The player receives these weapons in the [[Throne of Secrets]] area, from the various "Keeper" collectors in exchange for the [[Book of Secrets]], which the player receives from the [[Keeper of Secrets]].

The Forgotten weapons are:
